title.en: Google acquires DeepMind and ignites the AI talent race
title.zhHans: Google 收购 DeepMind，拉开 AI 人才竞赛序幕

searchSummary.en: Google acquires DeepMind in 2014 for £400M — the deal that started the AI talent race. How one acquisition concentrated world-leading AI talent inside a single company.
searchSummary.zhHans: Google 2014 年以 4 亿英镑收购 DeepMind——这一交易启动了全球 AI 人才争夺战。一次收购如何汇集了世界顶级的 AI 人才。

summary.en: On January 27, 2014, Google acquired DeepMind Technologies for approximately £400 million ($650 million), one of its largest European acquisitions. Founded by Demis Hassabis, Shane Legg, and Mustafa Suleyman, DeepMind was a London-based AI startup focused on general-purpose learning algorithms. The acquisition was the first clear signal that AI talent and research capability were strategic assets worth fighting for, setting off a decade of bidding wars for AI researchers and establishing DeepMind as the world's most respected AI lab.
summary.zhHans: 2014 年 1 月 27 日，Google 以约 4 亿英镑（6.5 亿美元）收购了 DeepMind Technologies，这是其在欧洲最大规模的收购之一。由 Demis Hassabis、Shane Legg 和 Mustafa Suleyman 创立的 DeepMind 是一家总部位于伦敦的 AI 初创公司，专注于通用学习算法。这次收购是第一个明确的信号：AI 人才和研究能力是值得争夺的战略资产，引发了长达十年的 AI 研究人员抢购战，并确立了 DeepMind 作为全球最受尊敬的 AI 实验室的地位。

narrative.en: DeepMind was founded in 2010 by Demis Hassabis (a former child chess prodigy and neuroscience PhD), Shane Legg (an AI researcher focused on measuring machine intelligence), and Mustafa Suleyman. The company's mission was ambitiously broad: solve intelligence, then use it to solve everything else. Before the acquisition, DeepMind had demonstrated algorithms capable of learning to play Atari games from raw pixels — a proof of concept that caught Google's attention. The deal included a clause establishing an AI ethics board, reflecting early awareness of the technology's risks. The acquisition's impact was profound. DeepMind's recruiting power attracted the world's best AI talent to London, creating a research powerhouse that produced AlphaGo (2016), AlphaFold (2020), and many more breakthroughs. The acquisition also showed Facebook, Microsoft, and Amazon that they needed to build and acquire AI capability or fall behind. The 'talent acquisition' model — buying a startup for its people rather than its products — became standard practice. The £400 million price tag seemed large in 2014 but was a bargain in retrospect — DeepMind's technologies and alumni would generate billions in value.
narrative.zhHans: DeepMind 成立于 2010 年，创始人是 Demis Hassabis（前国际象棋神童、神经科学博士）、Shane Legg（专注于衡量机器智能的 AI 研究者）和 Mustafa Suleyman。该公司的使命非常宏大：解决智能问题，然后用它来解决其他一切问题。在收购之前，DeepMind 已经展示了能够从原始像素学会玩 Atari 游戏的算法——这个概念验证引起了 Google 的注意。收购协议包含一条建立 AI 伦理委员会的条款，反映出对技术风险的早期意识。这次收购的影响深远。DeepMind 的招聘优势将全球最优秀的 AI 人才吸引到伦敦，创建了一个产出 AlphaGo（2016 年）、AlphaFold（2020 年）等众多突破的研发强国。这次收购也让 Facebook、微软和亚马逊看到：他们必须建立和获取 AI 能力，否则就会落后。"人才收购"模式——买一家初创公司是为了人而不是产品——成为了标准做法。4 亿英镑的价格在 2014 年看似巨大，但回顾来看是一笔划算的交易——DeepMind 的技术和校友创造了数十亿美元的价值。

description.en: Triggered the AI talent acquisition race. Established the model of buying AI startups for talent. Created DeepMind as the world's leading AI lab, enabling AlphaGo, AlphaFold, and other landmark breakthroughs.
description.zhHans: 引发了 AI 人才收购竞赛。确立了为人才收购 AI 初创公司的模式。将 DeepMind 打造为全球领先的 AI 实验室，催生了 AlphaGo、AlphaFold 等里程碑式突破。

text.en: Google acquired DeepMind for £400M on January 27, 2014. The deal included an ethics board clause and established DeepMind as Google's premier AI research lab.
text.zhHans: Google 于 2014 年 1 月 27 日以 4 亿英镑收购 DeepMind。协议包含伦理委员会条款，并将 DeepMind 确立为 Google 的顶级 AI 研究实验室。

sources.quote: Google pays £400m for DeepMind, a London-based artificial intelligence firm.
